annotations.text:
Terminal view — a second way to read the same chat, toggled by the new CHAT | TERM switch in the header band.

What changes: the thread becomes one mono stream on the code-slab surface — user turns are prompt echoes, tool calls are dim audit lines, the composer folds into a live prompt + statusline.

What stays airoom: the band, the pixel frame, room-accent trim, green=working / amber=needs-you, and the approval gate's anatomy.

Static mockups; the conversation is sample copy. Tweak chip above each frame previews the room accent.

Alternate: terminal thread, but today's composer kept.

For it: mode / model / attach stay discoverable, typing feels unchanged.
Against it: two surface styles stacked — the pure prompt (main direction) commits harder to the terminal feel.
